author: Inside Edition
description: Tom Green from Maryland has joined the McDaniel College football team's defensive line. An impressive feat since he is 60 years old. If he plays until he's 62, he will officially be the oldest person to ever play college football. Not only is this achievement exciting because of Tom's age, but also because there was a time when he fought to stay alive while battling stage-four cancer. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindal has more.
title: 60-Year-Old Cancer Survivor Joins College Football Team
